diagnostics.message: kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner references the AWSNodeTemplate named "default" via spec.providerRef.name, but that object is created by kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template. The two resources share no attribute reference or ordering (both only depend_on module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons), so Terraform may apply the Provisioner before its referenced node template exists, and Karpenter will fail to resolve providerRef when provisioning nodes.
